reviews.text:
False advertising. The developer clearly leads the user to believe there’s a free plan for the app - which there is not. In the App Store description, the developer states that a subscription unlocks premium features and unlocks full access to the app. Clearly, implying the app has some features that can be used for free.

The app opens with a screen that requires the user to purchase a subscription (3-day free trial offered) but there is no free option, no hidden “x” to close or bypass the page. If you’re going to require a subscription to open your app - be honest about it. Switch the description to say “a subscription is required to use this app” - users don’t appreciate being lied to or wasting their time.
